description: MCP server configuration for property-crawl. PostGIS is conditional — only starts when DATABASE_URL is set. Falls back to in-memory provider when unset (Base44 dev loop). Browser MCP is optional for UI verification.

postgres.condition: DATABASE_URL must be set. When unset, the agent uses the in-memory provider seeded from data.js and skips this server cleanly. Do NOT start if DATABASE_URL is empty or unset.
postgres.disabledReason: DATABASE_URL is not set in the Base44 dev environment. The in-memory provider in server/db/client.js is used instead. Set DATABASE_URL to a Postgres+PostGIS URL to enable.

playwright.condition: Optional. Used for UI verification of the Next.js marketing site. Requires Playwright browsers installed.
playwright.disabledReason: Playwright browsers are not installed in the current environment. Install with 'npx playwright install' to enable.

gracefulDegradation.description: When MCP servers are disabled or fail to start, the agent must continue operating using fallback mechanisms: in-memory DB (server/db/client.js) instead of PostGIS, DOM inspection instead of Playwright, and git/file inspection instead of GitHub MCP.

fallbacks.postgres: server/db/client.js in-memory provider seeded from data.js
fallbacks.playwright: DOM inspection via test/e2e.test.js and test/hardening.test.js
